stages: [BoundaryFlow] PASS rejected refunds restore actual unsettled/settled server states
[BoundaryFlow] PASS interrupted API connection and explicit UI read retry
[BoundaryFlow] PASS committed create response lost, original intent reconciled; one order, no debit
[CampusAcceptance] PASS UI settled partial refund through administrator
[CampusAcceptance] PASS UI unpaid cancellation and single order identity
[CampusAcceptance] PASS merchant net settlement after partial refund
environment: API 26 Pura X View emulator, 2210x2416 pixels, isolated package and backend

checks: refund filters and rejection buttons within screen

accountIsolation: A/B/A real authentication and server sync; addresses, carts and orders checked; hidden old page stacks cleared in test harness
network: Local proxy cuts actual API TCP connections and drops a successful order-create response after upstream commit. Retry uses original intent; one pending order and no debit. Does not emulate airplane mode, Wi-Fi roaming or campus network.
faultCountersScope: network-faults.json aggregates the two executed network cases; the first run failed a separate appearance locator and passed its network/account cases. The final complete run is 3/3.
limits: Affected pages and application maximum text scale only; not all-page accessibility or physical-device acceptance.
